ignore_arch.description: Ignore build logs from architectures matching the given string (can be repeated).

ignore_arch_flag.description: Ignore specific hardening flag on specific architecture (format: 'arch:flag').

ignore_arch_line.description: Ignore lines matching the given regexp only on specific architecture (format: 'arch:regexp').

ignore_flag.description: Ignore specific missing hardening flag (can be repeated).

ignore_line.description: Ignore lines matching the given Perl regex (can be repeated). Lines are auto-anchored at start/end.

build_flags.description: Explicit list of hardening flags to expect (e.g. ['-fPIE', '-Wl,-z,now']).

buildd_mode.description: Enable special mode for buildds (affects output format, exit code behavior, and auto-detection logic).

debian_mode.description: Enable Debian-specific settings (e.g. disable PIE check as GCC auto-injects it).

pie_mode.description: Force check for PIE flags (overrides auto-detection).

bindnow_mode.description: Force check for BINDNOW flags (overrides auto-detection).

all_mode.description: Force check for all hardening flags (+all, +pie, +bindnow) (overrides auto-detection).

color_output.description: Enable ANSI-colored output (if Term::ANSIColor is available).
